type Transfer struct {
	ID     string `json:"id"`

	To     string `json:"to"`
	Amount int64  `json:"amount"`
	Key    string `json:"-"`
}

decls.name: main

stubs.name: ServeHTTP
stubs.doc: ServeHTTP routes a request: it finds the Route whose Method equals r.Method and whose Pattern matches the path segment by segment ({} matches one non-empty segment), collects the {} segments as params, and calls Handle with l.mu held for the whole call. Any method or path no Route matches gets 404 "not found" (never 405).

stubs.name: WriteJSON
stubs.doc: WriteJSON sets Content-Type: application/json, writes status, and encodes v as JSON.

stubs.name: WriteError
stubs.doc: WriteError answers status with the body {"error": msg}, through WriteJSON.

stubs.name: Decode
stubs.doc: Decode reads r's body as JSON into v. On invalid JSON it writes 400 "invalid json" and returns false.

stubs.name: Amount
stubs.doc: Amount validates a decoded JSON value (from a map[string]any) as an amount: the spec's rule is an integer from 1 to 100000000.

stubs.name: Account
stubs.doc: Account returns the account with this id; if there is none it writes 404 "no such account" and returns nil.

stubs.name: View
stubs.doc: View is the account view the spec defines: id, balance, held, available (balance - held) and frozen.

stubs.name: Post
stubs.doc: Post is the only way any file changes a balance: it adds delta to a.Balance and appends one journal Entry (seq counting from 1 across the server, a.ID, delta, kind). kind is deposit, withdraw, transfer or capture.

stubs.name: Debitable
stubs.doc: Debitable applies every rule for taking or reserving n from a (withdrawals, outgoing transfers, new holds): a frozen account gives 423 "account frozen"; n above the available amount (balance - held) gives 409 "insufficient funds"; otherwise it returns 0, "". It changes nothing.
